features.description: Turn-lock (backend, correctness first) — transactional CAS on the existing group_sessions doc; acquire before the ADK run, release in finally, 409 on collision, 90s TTL steal. The atomic guard that prevents the concurrent-turn race (bug #3). MUST land first.
acceptance_criteria: acquire_turn_lock uses a Firestore transaction: two concurrent acquires return exactly one True and one False
A locked send surfaces HTTP 409 (turn_in_progress) from the student stream route before the SSE body starts; after release the next send succeeds
release_turn_lock clears only when the holding token matches; a foreign token cannot unlock a live turn
A lock older than the 90s TTL is stealable (a crashed/closed-tab turn does not wedge the group)
A proactive turn is skipped while a student turn holds the lock
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast green
features.notes: process_skill_request (skill_processor.py:68) has user.group_id + activity_id in scope; acquire at the top before the run so all four callers (student stream fast_api_app.py:644, proactive, mcp, channels) are serialized. Student route returns 409; proactive route skips when locked.

features.description: Live chat sync (fullstack, the headline) — GET /api/sessions/{id}/pulse {revision,turnInFlight,turnStartedAt} + useSessionPulse poll (~2-3s active, back off hidden) + refetch useSessionMessages on revision change + composer lock/queue on turnInFlight (409 -> queued -> auto-retry). Fixes bug #1 (no live sync); bug #2 (ghost context) falls out.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/sessions/{id}/pulse returns {revision,turnInFlight,turnStartedAt}, group-auth'd, zero LLM; revision bumps after a turn commits; turnInFlight reflects the non-stale M0 lock
Device B (same group+activity, not reloaded) sees device A's new user turn AND the tutor reply within one poll (~2-3s of commit)
While A's turn is in flight, B's composer is disabled showing 'tutor is answering your group…'; a message B types is auto-sent when the turn clears
A 409 from the stream POST flips the sender into the queued state and auto-retries on the next lock clear
useSessionMessages does not double-apply the sender's own in-flight stream via a pulse refetch; sentinel filter preserved; scroll/half-typed composer not disrupted
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast green AND cd frontend && npm run quality:check green
features.notes: revision source: prefer the ADK session event count if chat_sessions.turnCount lags; confirm the counter increments on EVERY committed turn (student + proactive) before wiring. All new fetches use the group token (fetchWithAuth), never the teacher helper.

features.description: Workbench state sync (fullstack) — add workbenchRevision to the pulse (bump on iframe-context write); other devices refetch iframe-context and reconcile element state (last-write-wins with convergence). Fixes bug #4 (workbench clobber). Groupmate trust-cards surface in the shared thread.
acceptance_criteria: The pulse carries workbenchRevision which bumps on each iframe-context write
Device A edits the table/calculator -> device B's workbench reflects it within a poll
Device B's subsequent edit does not silently erase A's; both devices converge to the same state (last-write-wins documented)
A groupmate's 'shared with the AI' trust-card is visible in the shared thread
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast green AND cd frontend && npm run quality:check green
features.notes: Simultaneous same-cell edit is an accepted edge (no CRDT/OT). Reuse the M1 pulse infrastructure — just an added field + a refetch trigger.

features.description: Presence (fullstack, optional) — activeDevices heartbeat count in the pulse (a count, not identities, per 'single group voice') + a '● live · N here' indicator + turn-lock phrasing 'a classmate is asking…'.
acceptance_criteria: The pulse carries activeDevices, a count of devices seen in a ~15s window (no per-student identity)
The student surface shows a '● live · N here' indicator that reflects the count and drops when a device leaves
The turn-lock message reads as 'a classmate is asking…' when N>1
cd backend && make lint && make test-fast green AND cd frontend && npm run quality:check green
